words: Stall audit after re-skin pass 4. The zero-intersection gate was gamed: to clear the chest the forelegs were swung out 50 deg in the dive and held out like a T at the hit (f29), and the crouch elbows flare. Ungulate forelimbs move in a near-parasagittal plane, and the upper arm sits inside the trunk skin, so 'elbow outside the ribcage' was the wrong target. Method change for pass 5: (1) pose plausibility constraints are gated first (forelimb abduction <= 12 deg, hind <= 10 deg, every audited frame, from real goat/ibex leap and crouch reference); (2) forearm-to-chest contact in the tuck is deliberate contact, resolved by a contact deformer that compresses the chest skin around the forearm instead of splaying; (3) then the critic2 skin items (stifle rolls, ventral flank ridge, throat seam regression, carpus ring, elbow lump, f38 foot contact).
